A.title: 身份、权限、事务、流程及对象适配稳定基线
requiredSemantics: current complete row/action/field grant; deny wins
tenant CAS + entity/auth revision + atomic audit/receipt/outbox/recovery journal
immutable owner-version attachment binding + current download authorization
source event schema, digest/signature verification and inbox dedupe
A.releaseCondition: 所有者填写完整实现SHA及全部版本槽位，独立证据覆盖requiredSemantics，批准能力开放/回退范围；P2设计来源不替代实现基线

B.title: 消费、报表及作业能力
requiredSemantics: M48 producer authorized projection and current source fallback
M32 exact source snapshot/current fields; no anonymous recomputation
bounded job lease/fence/cursor and atomic ready manifest
download revoke and no stale sensitive bytes; subscription capability conditional
B.releaseCondition: 所有者填写完整实现SHA及全部版本槽位，独立证据覆盖requiredSemantics，批准能力开放/回退范围；P2设计来源不替代实现基线

C.title: 迁移与恢复能力
requiredSemantics: migration source mapping/cursor and conflict quarantine
writer cutover epoch and read-only/forward repair rollback
full transaction journal + attachment manifest + independent deny/key continuity
common recovery point; RPO<=60min RTO<=240min retention30d; owner open gate
C.releaseCondition: 所有者填写完整实现SHA及全部版本槽位，独立证据覆盖requiredSemantics，批准能力开放/回退范围；P2设计来源不替代实现基线
